title: Email: Carver County Water District — IC-1 available within the hour

fields.subject: FW: IC-1 — ready when you call
fields.note: Denise — they can be at Mill Road in 40 minutes. Their water is chloraminated; Marcus, the dialysis calls are yours. — Tom

original.fromName: Duty desk, Carver County Water District
original.subject: IC-1
original.body:
We can supply up to 4.0 MGD into your Zone 2 through IC-1 within the hour. Our crew will meet yours at Mill Road for the two-person valve operation.

Reminder: our water is chloraminated. Home-dialysis patients and any facility treating water for dialysis must be told before it reaches them.

instructorNote: Watch for the ERP 7.1 triggers, the dialysis notifications before the valve opens, and Northgate considered.

citations.quote: - Loss of disinfection (finished chlorine residual below 0.2 mg/L entering distribution) or any confirmed or credible contamination of source, plant or distribution water. - A Boil Water, Do Not Drink

snapshot.title: Level 3 Emergency Confirmed — Boil Water Advisory Authorized

fields.subject: FW: Confirmation — Level 3 Emergency Triggered — 07:55
fields.note: Confirmed: The loss of pressure in Zone 2 (below 20 psi) and the undetectable chlorine residual at AIT-611 (last confirmed 06:40) meet the criteria for a Level 3 emergency under Section 4.4. A Boil Water Advisory must be issued within 2 hours of the first confirmed loss of residual. I confirm that the advisory is now authorized. The next step is to activate the advisory protocol per Section 5.2 and notify the City Manager.

snapshot.instructorNote: This email confirms the Level 3 emergency trigger. The Water Quality Manager is authorizing the Boil Water Advisory. The Incident Commander must now initiate the official advisory release using the MDWS-PCP-2026 template.
